title: Britain Fooled Hitler With A Dead Man And A Briefcase 💼
caption:
A dead man in a briefcase fooled an entire army 💼
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1943 British intelligence dressed a corpse as a fake Royal Marines officer, chained a briefcase of fake invasion plans to him and let him wash up in Spain. Germany took the bait. The Allies landed in Sicily on 10 July 1943.
Genius plan or too weird to work? 👇
first_comment: They even put fake theatre tickets in his pocket. Spies pay attention to details. Would YOU have caught it? 🎭👇
